utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep—I'm tracking Saturday at 10 by the community shed, and I’ll bring my basic tools.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect—that’s the plan I’ve been telling everyone: Saturday at 10 by the community shed, and thanks for bringing your tools.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, that matches what I’ve got too—Saturday at 10 by the community shed, and I’ll bring my basic tools.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Faye — quick update, the repair drive moved to Sunday at the community center; can you let me know if you can make it and what tools or help you might be able to bring?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks for the update—Sunday at the community center should be fine for me as long as it doesn’t run into school pickup, and I can bring a basic tool kit and help sort supplies.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s great, Faye—thank you; a basic tool kit and supply sorting will be really useful, and I’ll confirm the start time as soon as Opal locks it in so you can check it against school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, Sam, Cleo’s leading it, and I still need to double-check the exact start time, but I can help sort the screws and patch supplies meantime.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Oren—that helps a lot. I’m still set to come with my tools, and once the workspace is ready I’ll start on the chairs and then check the lamp.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, that sounds great, Sam. I’ll get the screws and patch supplies sorted now, and I’ll let you know once I’ve double-checked the start time with Cleo.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It’s coming together well—we’ve got people from a few different blocks interested, and Saturday afternoon is still the leading plan while we confirm with a couple more folks.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—timing first. If Saturday’s still leading, are we talking afternoon for sure now, or do we still need to pin the start time down?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Saturday afternoon’s still the plan we’re telling people, but I’m still waiting on a couple replies before I lock the exact start time in.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Saturday at 10 by the community shed is set, so I’m moving on to lining up volunteers next.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, thanks—that firm timing helps; send me the volunteer list and full repair list once you’ve got them, especially anything still unassigned.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Will do—I’ll pull together the volunteer list and the full repair list next, and I’ll flag anything still unassigned when I send it over.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Leo, the repair drive’s really picking up, so I’m spreading the word fast—folks can bring busted lamps and radios right over to Mara’s sorting table this Saturday afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good—just keep it Saturday at 10 at Mara’s place, and send lamps and radios to the sorting table so we don’t get jammed up.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Got it—Saturday at 10 at Mara’s place, and I’ll keep telling folks to bring lamps and radios straight to the sorting table.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Uli, sorry I’m late—how’s the repair drive going, and where can I jump in?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Still a bit tentative—I only know Sam’s on bike repairs and Lila’s bringing tools, since Cleo hasn’t fully confirmed Saturday yet. If you want to help, Rosa’s matching people to the gaps once the day firms up.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it—sorry I’m late. I’ll spread the word for now, and once Saturday’s confirmed I’m happy to bring my basic tools and help wherever Rosa needs me.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Nell, the repair drive’s really picking up—folks on Maple already dropped off a good stack of tools, and Mara’s setting up a sorting table so it should be easy to bring things by.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’s great to hear—I’d only heard second-hand that it’s this Saturday afternoon, and Rosa is the one who’s got the volunteer spots and tool details sorted out.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That sounds right, Nell—it's really gathering steam, and with Rosa handling the volunteer spots and Mara setting up that sorting table, folks should have an easy time pitching in.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Gus, what’s actually on the repair list right now, and are you the one bringing tools or is that Lila?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Right now it’s the wobbly chairs and that busted lamp, and I’m the one bringing the tools. We’re set for Saturday at 10 by the community shed.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good—who’s covering the chairs and lamp, and is anything else still unassigned?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: It’s coming together nicely, Hana—I’m finishing the drop-off timing and sorting plan this afternoon, and I’ll share the schedule later today so everyone has something clear to follow.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That sounds helpful, Eli—before we lock anything in, can you confirm whether Cleo has actually set the day yet, or if Saturday is still just tentative?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Saturday afternoon is the day Vik confirmed, Hana, so I’m setting the timing plan around that and I’ll send the full schedule later today.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Okay, thanks, Cleo—I’ve got Sam on bike repairs, Lila bringing tools, and you covering the kit at Mara’s table, but the other jobs are still open.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Got it—I’m keeping the basic kit, screws, and patch supplies sorted at Mara’s table, so send anyone spare my way and I’ll slot them in.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Okay... thanks, Cleo—I’ll keep asking around one by one, and if anyone’s free I’ll send them to Mara’s table with you.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Kira, I’ve got the repair drive pinned to the community center lot this afternoon, and I’m confirming the exact start time next.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm the actual start time and whether Gus is definitely the one bringing the tools before we count on it?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m confirming the exact start time now, and I can check on Gus too, but the only tool commitment I’ve got noted so far is Bo bringing basic tools on Saturday.
